other_conditions: Applicant must have their registered office in India
Applicant must have appropriate experience in breeding or rearing dairy animals
Applicant must own or lease at least 5 acres of land (ownership/lease deed required)
Applicant must arrange procurement of feed and fodder for the farm
Applicant must establish a breed multiplication farm with at least 200 milch cows or buffalo
benefits_summary: Provides up to 50 % capital subsidy (capped at Rs 2 crore) for construction of cattle sheds, equipment, and elite bull procurement to set up breed multiplication farms.
